summary: Phison Electronics, a NAND controller maker, said first-half consolidated revenue in 2026 surpassed NT$100 billion (US$3.1 billion) for the first time. title: HIWIN and Hiwin Mikrosystem post record June sales on semiconductor and robotics demand

title: Notebook shipment update, May 2026
summary: In May 2026, combined shipments from the top five notebook brands increased by approximately 8% month-over-month. However, shipments by brand vendors were still down about 6% compared with May 2025.

title: CXMT IPO leaves HBM off the funding list, tempering China AI memory hype

title: Power-Win sees stronger momentum as battery recycling market expands

title: Chinese Rockchip expects 1H26 revenue and profit to rise on AIoT demand

title: Apple's Broadcom deal extension shows wireless independence remains a distant dream

title: Rebellions' IPO plan tests market appetite for inference chips

title: GlobalWafers says wafer demand is improving as chip cycle heals

The company said strong AI-related demand and high utilization supported the latest results.

title: Planet Technology reports June revenue growth as it expands cybersecurity lineup

The top-end Ultra model, however, is still likely to use Snapdragon across the board.

title: Shanghai Fudan Microelectronics forecasts sharp rise in 1H26 profit

title: Inventec expects server shipments to rise quarterly as component shortages loom
summary: Inventec reported June 2026 revenue of NT$102.26 billion (approx.
